title: English Practice Quiz 0947
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A patient asks for directions to the laboratory. You should ___.
options: give clear directions or guide them to the correct desk
tell them to enter a restricted area
questions.explanation: Clear directions help patients reach the correct department safely.

questions.question: Patient information should be discussed ___.
options: only with authorised people in an appropriate setting
on an open social media page
questions.explanation: Patient information must be protected and shared only when authorised.

questions.question: If a patient or relative is distressed, staff should first ___.
questions.explanation: Calm listening can help reduce distress and clarify the concern.

questions.question: A hospital wayfinding sign should be ___.
options: clear, readable and easy to follow
placed where nobody can see it
questions.explanation: Clear signs help people navigate the hospital.

questions.question: When communicating an emergency alert, staff should use ___.
options: the approved code and communication procedure
a personal nickname for the event
questions.explanation: Approved terminology reduces confusion during emergencies.

questions.question: A visitor who wants clinical advice should be directed to ___.
questions.explanation: Clinical advice should come from an appropriately qualified professional.

questions.question: A shift handover in a hospital should include relevant safety concerns and ___.
questions.explanation: Pending actions help the incoming team maintain continuity.

questions.question: When giving a patient an instruction, use language that is ___.
If you cannot understand a patient's language, you should seek ___.
options: a random online translation of private records
questions.explanation: Appropriate interpretation helps ensure accurate communication.

questions.question: A complaint about hospital service should be recorded according to ___.
questions.explanation: The approved process ensures the complaint is documented and reviewed appropriately.
